clue.text: Stroke or dash

definitions.meaning: a stroke played with the back of the hand, as in tennis
dash is a West African word for a bribe or tip, which is slipped across secretly

explanation.surface: A choice between two quick movements, a stroke or a dash.
explanation.definitionFit: A tennis shot played across the body is one sense; a bribe, called a dash in West Africa, is the other.

clue.text: A gun for each person

parts.note: piece is slang for a gun

explanation.surface: Someone hands out one firearm to every individual.
explanation.definitionFit: Apiece means individually, one to every member of a group.

clue.text: Quickly produce something that's superb

definitions.meaning: to ... a piece of work is to make it fast
a stunner or sensation, something excellent

explanation.surface: Rapidly creating something excellent.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: to dash off work rapidly, and a stunning, outstanding thing or person.

clue.text: Replicate a composition, a religious work

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: a composition is something put together, so the letters before it are arranged anew

explanation.surface: Copying a musical composition that happens to be sacred.
explanation.walkthrough: 'composition' looks like the musical work being copied, but it signals rearranging REPLICATE plus A.
explanation.definitionFit: A painted or carved panel set behind a church's communion table is a devotional work of art.

clue.text: Do a critical examination in little girl's school

parts.note: Di, short for Diana, is a little girl's name, here with 's
a school of thought is a sect

explanation.surface: A critical inspection is carried out at a young girl's school.
explanation.definitionFit: To dissect is to analyse something minutely, as a critic picks apart a work.

clue.text: Queen, an Indian leader

parts.note: R stands for Regina, Latin for queen
taken as written

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter, here of Indian

explanation.surface: A queen who rules in India.
explanation.definitionFit: A rani is the wife of a rajah or a reigning Hindu princess, a royal ruler in India.

clue.text: Current records are so wild

definitions.meaning: records still standing have not been beaten
an untamed horse has not been trained to the saddle

explanation.surface: The latest records are untamed and crazy.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: records not yet surpassed, and a horse never tamed or trained to ride.

clue.text: Simple way in which to find 18 people

parts.note: simple means easy
a street is a way or road

explanation.surface: A straightforward route to locating a group of people.
explanation.walkthrough: 18 is the answer to 18-down, prosperous people; they are found living a life of comfort.
explanation.definitionFit: Being on this proverbial road means living in affluence, where the comfortably rich are found.

clue.text: Girl in headquarters of American army

annotationWithheld.why: Girl in headquarters of American army (6), as printed on the scan: no parse found that builds AMANDA from 'headquarters of American army'
annotationWithheld.clue: Girl in headquarters of American army

clue.text: Ores pits put out producing quick returns

indicators.note: put out suggests the letters are disturbed and laid out differently

explanation.surface: Mining spoil is dumped and yields a fast profit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'quick returns' hints at money but means sharp replies.
explanation.definitionFit: Ripostes are swift, witty retorts, quick comebacks in an argument or fencing thrusts.

clue.text: Artist tucked into meagre fish

indicators.note: one piece is tucked inside another, so it goes into the middle

parts.note: meagre means stingy, scant
RA is a Royal Academician, an artist

explanation.surface: A painter eats a skimpy fish dinner.
explanation.definitionFit: A stingray is a flat sea creature with a venomous tail spine, a kind of fish.

clue.text: Fabric repeatedly found in sale, not economical enough

indicators.note: the letters lie inside the run of words, and occur more than once in it

explanation.surface: A cloth often seen in bargain sales which is not quite cheap enough.
explanation.walkthrough: The four letters sit in 'saLE NOt' and again in 'economicaL ENOugh', hence 'repeatedly'.
explanation.definitionFit: Leno is an open gauze-like weave of cloth, used for curtains.

clue.text: American's crazy proposal could be a moving experience

parts.note: loco is American slang for mad
a motion is a proposal put to a meeting

explanation.surface: A wild US suggestion might prove emotionally stirring.
explanation.walkthrough: 'moving' seems to mean touching, but it means literally travelling.
explanation.definitionFit: Locomotion is travel from place to place, so the experience is literally one of moving.

clue.text: Choose isolated area for a dip

parts.note: to pick is to choose
a pocket is a small isolated patch, as of resistance

explanation.surface: Select a secluded spot to go for a swim.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dip' suggests a swim but is slang for a thief who picks pockets.
explanation.definitionFit: Dip is old slang for a petty thief who steals from people's clothing.

clue.text: Foreign magazine featuring Helen's marriage?

definitions.meaning: a weekly French news and pictures magazine
Helen of Troy eloped with the Trojan prince Paris, a union or match

explanation.surface: An overseas periodical covering the wedding of a woman called Helen.
explanation.definitionFit: The French weekly's title also reads as the mythical pairing of Helen with her Trojan lover.

clue.text: Moved king to safety, escorted by company

parts.note: a cast is a company of actors
led means escorted, guided

explanation.surface: A monarch is moved to safety with a guard of attendants.
explanation.walkthrough: In chess, castling moves the king beside a rook to shelter it.
explanation.definitionFit: In chess, castling shifts the king two squares towards a rook, tucking it behind pawns for protection.

clue.text: Person supporting our present monarch

parts.note: when this was set, Elizabeth II reigned: the second of that name
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the queen's cipher

explanation.surface: A subject who backs the reigning queen.
explanation.definitionFit: At a meeting, the person who backs a motion after its proposer formally supports it.

clue.text: Cake that is produced with chocolate

parts.note: chocolate is a colour, brown
ie is the abbreviation of id est, that is

explanation.surface: A dessert made using chocolate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'chocolate' looks like the cake's ingredient but is the colour.
explanation.definitionFit: A brownie is a small dense square of chocolate sponge, a kind of cake.

clue.text: Comfortable job for a boring person?

definitions.meaning: someone who bores holes in the ground has a ..., to dig

explanation.surface: A cushy job for a dull individual.
explanation.definitionFit: Prosperous people are comfortably off; and digging a shaft for water is a task for a driller.

clue.text: Initially set Northern brewer a wonderful example

indicators.note: initially means take the first letter of the next word, set

parts.note: in northern England tea is mashed rather than brewed, so a brewer is a masher

explanation.surface: A northern beer-maker sets a fine standard.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brewer' points to beer, but in northern English dialect to mash is to brew tea.
explanation.definitionFit: A smasher is informal British praise for a terrific person or thing.

clue.text: Second of two boys is back for a term

parts.note: Michael is a boy's name

indicators.note: is back says this boy's name is read backwards

parts.note: Sam is another boy's name

explanation.surface: The younger of two brothers returns to school for the new term.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Second of' marks that only the second name, Sam, is turned round to MAS.
explanation.definitionFit: Michaelmas is the autumn session at Oxford, Cambridge and some schools, named after the feast of St Michael.

clue.text: It could be either fast or slow, almost

indicators.note: almost means the word falls one letter short of complete

parts.note: lento is the musical direction meaning slow

explanation.surface: A thing that might be quick or slow, nearly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'It could be either' sets up both readings; the period before Easter is a fast.
explanation.definitionFit: The forty days before Easter are a Christian season of fasting and abstinence.

clue.text: Explorer in multiple North Sea disaster

indicators.note: a disaster leaves things in disorder, so the letters are scrambled

parts.note: N is north, and multiple calls for several copies, here three

explanation.surface: An explorer caught up in a catastrophe off the North Sea coast.
explanation.walkthrough: Fridtjof Nansen was the Norwegian polar explorer.
explanation.definitionFit: Fridtjof Nansen led the Fram expedition across the Arctic, a famous polar traveller.

clue.text: Case for guarding port, for example, clearly shown

definitions.text: Case for guarding port, for example, clearly shown

parts.words: Case for guarding port, for example, clearly shown
parts.note: a locked stand for spirit decanters that keeps them visible but out of reach, like the Greek figure tormented by fruit and water he could see

explanation.surface: A display cabinet guarding a fortified wine bottle in plain view.
explanation.walkthrough: 'port' tempts towards a harbour, but it is the wine.
explanation.definitionFit: This lockable decanter stand displays bottles behind bars, tantalisingly visible yet untouchable.

clue.text: Memoirs showing animation

definitions.meaning: a biography or account of a person's days
liveliness, vigour, as in full of spirit

explanation.surface: Recollections that display liveliness.
explanation.definitionFit: A written biography is one sense; vitality and spirit is the other.

clue.text: Delicate situation when politicians get excited

definitions.meaning: a heated greenhouse is where delicate plants are kept
a chamber of parliament, the House, becomes hot or heated

explanation.surface: Tricky circumstances as MPs grow agitated.
explanation.definitionFit: A heated glasshouse shelters tender plants; and a heated parliamentary chamber is a hot House.

clue.text: Something unique — about English cricket sides

indicators.note: about means going round, so the sides surround the letter for English

parts.note: the leg side, also called on, and off are the two halves of a cricket field

explanation.surface: A rare event concerning England's cricket teams.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sides' suggests teams, but in cricket on and off are halves of the field either side of the batter.
explanation.definitionFit: A one-off is a singular occurrence or item, never repeated.

clue.text: Pedestrian has to jump onto ground

indicators.note: onto places the leap after the soil in the entry

parts.note: earth means ground, soil
to bound is to leap

explanation.surface: A walker must leap onto solid land.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pedestrian' looks like a walker but means dull and unimaginative.
explanation.definitionFit: Unable to soar above the ground, so prosaic and uninspired in thought.
